clue.text: Trunk or back of jacket

parts.note: a bole is the trunk of a tree

indicators.note: back says the little word or is turned round to run the other way

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A tailor wonders whether to use the main body or the rear panel of a coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trunk' looks like luggage or an elephant's nose; here it is a tree's main stem, and 'back' turns only the little word after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A bolero is a short open jacket ending above the waist, as worn by Spanish dancers.

clue.text: Crowd turns on poet to throw things

indicators.note: turns tells us the word for the crowd faces the other way

parts.note: a mob is a crowd
a bard is a poet

explanation.surface: An angry crowd rounds on a poet and starts pelting him.
explanation.definitionFit: To bombard is to attack with a stream of missiles, literally throwing things at a target.

clue.text: Slowly advanced to zero

parts.note: lent means advanced, as money is advanced on loan
O looks like zero

explanation.surface: A loan crept up gradually until nothing was left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'advanced' looks like motion, but it is the money sense: a loan advanced is lent.
explanation.definitionFit: Lento is the musical direction meaning to play at a slow tempo.

clue.text: Creating new school classes for improving past record

definitions.meaning: ... school forms, the British word for classes, means making them up afresh
... an offender means getting someone with a criminal record to mend their ways

explanation.surface: A school reorganises its classes to raise its poor results.
explanation.definitionFit: Reforming means correcting a wrongdoer, and re-forming means forming forms, i.e. school classes, again.

clue.text: Louis seen taking small pieces out of mushroom

indicators.note: Louis is seen placed within the small pieces, which take him in

parts.note: bits are small pieces
Lew is a short form of the name Louis

explanation.surface: A man named Louis is spotted picking bits off a mushroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen taking' is loosely worded: it is Louis who is taken inside the small pieces, not the other way round.
explanation.definitionFit: The blewit is an edible wild mushroom with a lilac-blue stem.

clue.text: Ordered fabulous bird to appear in rich fabric

indicators.note: the bird is made to appear inside the word for ordered

parts.note: bade means ordered, the past tense of bid
the roc is a giant bird of Arabian legend

explanation.surface: A mythical bird is commanded to turn up woven in luxurious cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Brocade is a rich silk fabric woven with a raised pattern, often in gold or silver thread.

clue.text: Point light at wild animal

parts.note: E, east, is a point of the compass
to light is to land, as a bird lights on a branch

explanation.surface: Someone shines a torch on a creature in the wild.
explanation.walkthrough: 'light' is a verb meaning alight or settle, not a lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: The eland is a large African antelope, a wild grazing animal.

clue.text: Manager is mean to worker

parts.note: to mean to do something is to intend it
an ant is the classic crossword worker

explanation.surface: A boss is said to be stingy towards a member of staff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mean' looks like an adjective, stingy, but it is the verb intend.
explanation.definitionFit: An intendant is a superintendent or administrator, as in the director of an opera house.

clue.text: Way to sit on a horse to make progress

definitions.text: Way to sit on a horse
definitions.meaning: to ... a horse, in the old sense, is to sit astride it with a leg each side
to ... forward is to advance well

explanation.surface: A riding lesson on seat position helps the pupil improve.
explanation.definitionFit: Stride can mean to straddle, and also to walk with long steps, hence to advance well.

clue.text: Condition of landed property …

definitions.meaning: ... in the old sense means state or condition, as in man's ...

explanation.surface: A surveyor reports on the state of a country estate.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis runs the surface on into 14-down; the wordplay stands alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Estate means a person's state in life, and also a large area of land under one owner.

clue.text: Reveal circle responsible for party programme

parts.note: to manifest is to reveal or show
O is circle-shaped

explanation.surface: A party disclose which group drew up its policy plans.
explanation.definitionFit: A manifesto is a published declaration of a political party's policies before an election.

clue.text: Change from the usual terrible selection

indicators.note: from shows the letters are taken out of the words that follow
a selection of letters from the run of words gives the answer

explanation.surface: A critic laments a departure from the usual dreadful choice on offer.
explanation.definitionFit: To alter is to change or modify something.

clue.text: A doctor rejecting sport for love

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is a doctor

indicators.note: rejecting turns the sport's abbreviation back on itself

parts.note: RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: A physician gives up a game in favour of romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejecting' turns RU into UR at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Amour is a love affair, borrowed from the French word for love.

clue.text: Given up as very wicked

definitions.meaning: an ... person is utterly depraved, lost to all restraint

explanation.surface: Someone renounced as thoroughly evil.
explanation.definitionFit: Abandoned means left behind, and also shamelessly unrestrained or depraved.

clue.text: Refuse to provide different cases

definitions.meaning: to ... an invitation is to refuse it
to ... a noun in grammar is to give its forms in each case

explanation.surface: Someone will not supply alternative containers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cases' looks like boxes, but it is the grammatical case, as in Latin nominative and accusative.
explanation.definitionFit: Decline means to refuse politely, and in grammar to list a noun's case endings.

clue.text: … in the period just prior of firing nobleman in adversity?

definitions.text: the period just prior of firing

parts.note: a count is a European nobleman
to be down is to be suffering bad times

explanation.surface: Continuing 8-down, a noble estate falls on hard times just before the guns go off.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the loose 'in adversity' for DOWN.
explanation.definitionFit: A countdown is the backward count of seconds immediately before a rocket launch or explosion.

clue.text: Measure back portion of catch

parts.note: an en is a printer's unit of measure

indicators.note: back reverses the word for a portion

parts.note: a part is a portion

explanation.surface: Someone sizes up the rear section of a haul.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses the portion word rather than asking for the end of 'catch'; an en is half an em, a typesetting width.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrap is to catch someone by trickery, as in a snare.

clue.text: Convey ecstasy

definitions.meaning: to ... goods is to carry them
a ... of joy is a state of rapture

explanation.surface: Pass on overwhelming delight.
explanation.definitionFit: Transport means to carry from place to place, and also an overwhelming emotion such as rapture.

clue.text: Reptile that attacks people in the street

definitions.text: that attacks people in the street
definitions.meaning: a street robber who assaults victims

explanation.surface: A creature who assaults passers-by in town.
explanation.definitionFit: A mugger is a marsh crocodile of India and also a street robber who attacks people.

clue.text: Go back to pay for another round

definitions.meaning: to ... friends is to stand them drinks again

explanation.surface: Return so as to buy the next drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: Retreat means to withdraw, and split as re-treat it means to treat someone again.

clue.text: Furious at French caper

parts.note: an antic is a playful caper

explanation.surface: Someone is enraged at a Gallic prank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caper' is a prank, not the pickled flower bud.
explanation.definitionFit: Frantic means wildly agitated or frenzied, close to furious in the sense of violent haste.

clue.text: Measure affinity to tree

indicators.note: to means one piece is added to the other

parts.note: a fir is a conifer
kin are relatives, those with a family affinity

explanation.surface: Gauge how closely related someone is to a family tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A firkin is an old measure of capacity, a quarter of a barrel, used for beer.

clue.text: Is girl able to produce spice from cinnamon?

parts.note: to be able is to be capable, so can
Ella is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A question whether a young woman can make seasoning out of cinnamon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is girl able' asks 'Can Ella?', so the verb comes first, giving CAN then ELLA.
explanation.definitionFit: Canella is the aromatic bark of the white cinnamon tree, used as a spice.

clue.text: The latest about American currency

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a cent is a coin of US currency

explanation.surface: The newest report concerns the dollar.
explanation.definitionFit: Recent means lately happened, so it can stand for the latest.

clue.text: He gets something out of old vehicle

parts.note: ex means former
a tractor is a farm vehicle

explanation.surface: A man retrieves something from a vintage car.
explanation.definitionFit: An extractor is a person or device that draws something out, like a fan or a tooth-puller.

clue.text: Tree given by Lincoln to the French

parts.note: Abe is Abraham Lincoln's familiar name
le is the French word for the

explanation.surface: A president presents a tree to France.
explanation.definitionFit: The abele is the white poplar tree.

clue.text: Young man taking single bird out

indicators.note: taking says the bird takes in the single

parts.note: a swan is a bird
I, the Roman numeral one, is single

explanation.surface: A youth takes an unattached girl on a date.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bird' looks like a girlfriend, but it is the swan, holding I.
explanation.definitionFit: A swain is a young lover or suitor, especially a country youth.

clue.text: Imitating a gentle sound

parts.note: a ping is a soft ringing sound

explanation.surface: Copying a soft noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Aping means copying or mimicking, as apes are thought to do.

clue.text: Peel off without a ring to Gretna Green?

definitions.text: Peel off without a ring to Gretna Green?

indicators.note: without means outside, so the scrambled word goes round the ring
off says the letters of peel are thrown out of order

parts.note: O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A couple slip away with no wedding ring to the famous Scottish marriage village.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges PEEL as ELPE, and 'without' wraps it round O. Gretna Green is the Scottish border village where English couples used to run off to marry.
explanation.definitionFit: To elope is to run off secretly to marry, classically at Gretna Green.

clue.text: Journalist's one man that could be a leader

parts.note: an editor is a journalist in charge
I is the Roman numeral one
Al is a man's name

explanation.surface: A newspaperman's colleague might become the boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' is the British word for a newspaper's main opinion column.
explanation.definitionFit: An editorial is the newspaper article giving the paper's opinion, called a leading article.

clue.text: A touching line, but not in verse

definitions.text: A touching line, but not in verse

parts.words: A touching line, but not in verse
parts.note: a moving line suggests poetry, but the line meant is a geometric one meeting a curve at one point

explanation.surface: A moving line, though not one found in poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry a tangent is a straight line touching a curve at a single point.

clue.text: Brand displayed in flower centre

definitions.meaning: a mark of disgrace, a brand
the pollen-receiving tip of a flower's pistil

explanation.surface: A mark seen in the heart of a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Stigma means a mark of shame, and in botany the part of the pistil at a flower's centre.
